ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with a very low white-to-black ratio; high-intensity pixels are limited to small localized speckling and specular water reflections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire continuous trailing edge; the left lobe displays higher peak-to-valley pixel amplitude than the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the lateral tips; tips are characterized by irregular, non-linear bulbous geometries.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small, circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) primarily concentrated on the mid-to-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast, granular-textured protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
